sql:
SELECT SUM(VLEClicks) AS TotalVLEClicks
FROM oulad_dw.vle_clicks

SELECT module_code, COUNT(*) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
GROUP BY module_code

SELECT code_presentation, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE module = 'BBB'
GROUP BY code_presentation

SELECT activity_type, SUM(clicks) as total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
GROUP BY activity_type
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT activity_group, SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE activity_group != 'No-activity'
GROUP BY activity_group

SELECT week_num, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE presentation_id = 'DDD-2013B'
  AND course_week BETWEEN 1 AND 10
GROUP BY week_num

SELECT code_presentation, COUNT(*) 
FROM oulad_dw 
WHERE module_name = 'AAA' 
GROUP BY code_presentation

SELECT 
    code_module,
    ROUND((SUM(amount) / COUNT(*)) * 100, 1) AS percentage
FROM 
    oulad_dw
WHERE 
    amount > 0
GROUP BY 
    code_module

SELECT final_result, COUNT(*) 
FROM oulad_dw 
WHERE final_result IN ('CCC-2014J') 
GROUP BY final_result

SELECT code_module, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS average_score
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE module_type != 'banked'
GROUP BY code_module

    outcome_group,
    ROUND(AVG(total_clicks), 1) AS average_total_clicks

    oulad_dw

SELECT module_presentation, COUNT(*) AS zero_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE course_week = 1 AND clicks = 0
GROUP BY module_presentation

SELECT AVG(T2.active_days) AS average_active_days
FROM oulad_dw.course_week AS T1
JOIN oulad_dw.course_week_click AS T2 ON T1.course_week_id = T2.course_week_id
WHERE T1.course_week_name = 'Week 2' AND T1.course_year = '2013J' AND T2.clicked_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY T2.student_id
ORDER BY average_active_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT gender, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM oulad_dw
GROUP BY gender

SELECT highest_education, COUNT(*) 
FROM oulad_dw 
WHERE result = 'Distinction' 
GROUP BY highest_education

SELECT id_assessment, due_day, ROUND(AVG(score) - AVG(banked_score), 1) AS mean_score
FROM oulad_dw
WHERE id_assessment IN (
    SELECT id_assessment
    FROM oulad_dw
    WHERE due_day = 'AAA-2013J'
)
GROUP BY id_assessment, due_day

WITH ROLLUP AS (
    SELECT 
        code_module,
        code_presentation,
        SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks
    FROM 
        oulad_dw
    GROUP BY 
        code_module, 
        code_presentation
    WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT 
    code_module,
    code_presentation,
    total_clicks
FROM 
    ROLLUP
ORDER BY 
    code_module, 
    code_presentation

SELECT module_presentation, ROUND(SUM(clicks) / COUNT(enrolled_student), 1) AS total_clicks_per_enrolled_student
FROM oulad_dw
GROUP BY module_presentation
ORDER BY total_clicks_per_enrolled_student DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT code_module, assessment_type, COUNT(*) AS assessment_count
FROM oulad_dw

SELECT phase, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks

SELECT activity_group,

SELECT code_module, COUNT(*) 
FROM oulad_dw

    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 1 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 2 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_week = 3 THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS week3

    oulad_dw

    activity_group

SELECT module_presentation, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS average_score

SELECT MAX(clicks) AS max_clicks

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_type)

SELECT code_module, COUNT(*)
